_comment: The art lives here. Edit freely, no code changes needed. Subjects are BARE noun phrases with no article: the template adds 'a'/'an'. Theme: 'a world as a gift, for the kid I used to be', so the vocabulary is childhood objects at monument scale.

subject: stack of tin drums and bicycle wheels
playground climbing frame
scaffold of swing sets welded together
sleeping stone animal half sunk into the earth
mossy boulder shaped like a sofa
upturned hull of a buried wooden boat
tree grown out of brass instruments and copper pipes
chandelier of hanging toys and music boxes
spiral staircase of stacked books and radios
child-sized figure folded from paper lanterns
lit paper lantern on a tall thin pole
empty wooden chair with a glowing coat draped over it
washing line strung with paper kites
fence woven from bicycle spokes and fishing wire
row of wind chimes hung from a dead tree
upright piano with the front panel removed, ivy in the strings
staircase of piano keys climbing into nothing
music stand holding an open book the size of a door

style_suffix: single isolated object on a plain background, soft diffuse light, nostalgic childhood memory, matte painterly textures, no text
negative_prompt: text, watermark, people, photorealistic skin, gore, weapons, logos, background scenery
